compressed_app_deployment.profile_override: No enabling loop setting found in inspected mt7628 files, snsv2 configs or top-level .config files. Package selection and generated final kernel config are not established.
compressed_app_deployment.conclusion: App-only SquashFS size is a packaging measurement, not proof this file can be mounted by stock firmware. Do not use protected flash partitions to avoid loop support.
compressed_app_deployment.alternative: XZ-to-RAM execution requires a proven stock decompressor or an additional loader, plus executable tmpfs, memory headroom, and safe persistent startup. None is verified on 11565.

persistence_source_followup.observed: CommitConfig writes a temporary file, calls DataSync (fdatasync) then rename. This function does not sync the parent directory after rename.
persistence_source_followup.limitation: This source observation does not establish loss on the target JFFS2 implementation. Existing SIGKILL tests do not emulate sudden power loss, and Windows source must be compared with native pinned build before any patch.
